result:
Comments, deletion, reporting and the three-report hide rule are implemented. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass (28 tests), and `bunx guren gate` is green on all six stages. Nothing is committed.

Things you might not expect:

- **Post and comment deletion clean up in application code.** The foreign keys declare `ON DELETE CASCADE`, but SQLite leaves foreign-key enforcement off on a fresh connection here. Both deletes therefore remove dependent comments and reports explicitly, inside a transaction. I checked this with enforcement on and off.
- **Comment bodies are trimmed before the 1–2000 check**, the same way post titles are, so a whitespace-only comment is rejected.
- **Guests see a "Sign in to comment" link** in place of the comment box, and no Report or Delete buttons.
- **I added an ADR** (`docs/adr/0002-community-moderation-of-comments.md`, status draft) recording the rules and the cascade caveat. It wasn't requested.

**Summary of changes:** I added the `comments` and `comment_reports` tables to `db/schema.ts`, with a unique index on (`comment_id`, `user_id`), and generated the migration `db/migrations/20260929135027_add_comments`. New models are `app/Models/Comment.ts` (which holds the threshold of 3, the visible-comments query and the delete-with-reports helper) and `app/Models/CommentReport.ts`, and `Post` gained a `comments` relation. `app/Policies/CommentPolicy.ts` is registered in `app/Providers/AuthorizationProvider.ts`; `app/Http/Validators/CommentValidator.ts`, `app/Http/Resources/CommentResource.ts` and `app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts` (store, destroy, report) are new. `routes/web.ts` has the three routes behind the existing `auth` middleware: `POST /posts/:id/comments`, `DELETE /comments/:id` and `POST /comments/:id/report`. `PostController.show` now passes `comments` to `posts/Show`, and `PostController.destroy` removes the post's comments and reports. `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` renders the comment list, the comment form, and Delete/Report controls. The `.guren/*.gen.ts` manifests are regenerated, and the feature tests are in `tests/CommentController.test.ts`.
